title: KnowledgeSourceDescriptor
description: Descriptor for a Knowledge Source (KS). KSs are Pack-shipped sandboxed Java JARs. KSs are unaware of each other; ordering is data-driven via triggerPredicate over Blackboard state. No `dependsOn` between KSs.

writesSlots.description: Contribution-type names within writesPanel that this KS may post (subset of the keys of the panel's closed slots map).

readsPanels.description: Panels this KS reads (must be subset of dependsOnPanels* of writesPanel in the panel DAG).

triggerPredicate.description: Fully-qualified Java class name (loaded from the Pack JAR) implementing the engine's KsTriggerPredicate interface: `boolean test(BlackboardView view, SourcingRunContext ctx)`. Evaluated by the Sourcer Controller per scheduling tick. BlackboardView exposes typed Java accessors (resolved(panel, identity), contributionsOf(panel, identity), evidenceOf(identity), confidenceBelow(identity, threshold), statementAmbiguous(identity), validationFailed(identity), count(...), runContext().scope().includes(identity), ...) so triggers are expressed in plain Java. There is NO string DSL.

appliesToInterpretationKinds.description: Optional fast-pruning hint over slot names of read panels.

resolverHint.description: Recommended ContributionResolver for the writesPanel; RunConfig may override. `compose` = schema-driven per-key merging of value objects (engine merge function over the resolved JSON Schema); use it for panels whose value carries independent fields contributed by multiple KSs (e.g. Statement).

externalTools.description: Whitelisted external binaries this KS will execve via ControlContext.tool(name). Engine enforces: tool must be (a) declared here AND (b) bound in RunConfig.externalToolBindings.

budget.description: Per-tick budget caps. Engine enforces by cooperative cancellation at the next ControlContext call (.post / .resolved / .tool / .inference / .defman). On hard limit (e.g. wallClockMs reached during a blocking syscall), the engine cancels execve, drops the KS's pending posts in this tick, posts a Diagnostic, and re-enqueues the KS for the next tick (capped retries via RunConfig.ksBudgetOverrides).
